#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

bool check(int w, int m) {
    while (m != 0) {
        int r = m % w;
        if (r == 0 || r == 1) {
            m /= w;
        } else if (r == w - 1) {
            m = (m + 1) / w;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    int w, m;
    cin >> w >> m;
    cout << (check(w, m) ? "YES" : "NO") << endl;
    return 0;
}
